info.title: doc-exporter
info.description: Extensible .NET CLI tool (doc-exporter) that exports C# assemblies, solutions, and XML docs into Microsoft Learn-style MkDocs Markdown, Mermaid/PlantUML diagrams, navigation manifests, and CI quality reports.

commands.name: assembly
commands.description: Export documentation for one or more compiled assemblies (.dll)

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to the compiled target assembly file (.dll)

options.name: --xml
options.description: Path to the compiler-generated XML documentation file (.xml) []

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Optional project or assembly names and wildcard patterns (e.g. '*.Tests', '*.Benchmarks') to exclude when exporting []

options.name: --exclude-types
options.description: Optional type names or wildcard patterns (e.g. '*Internal*') to exclude from generated documentation []

options.name: --exclude-namespaces
options.description: Optional namespace names or wildcard patterns (e.g. '*.Migrations') to exclude from generated documentation []

options.name: --exclude-editor-browsable-never
options.description: Automatically excludes types and members decorated with [EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]. [default: True]

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output directory for generated Markdown files

options.name: --examples-dir
options.description: Optional directory containing external code example snippets

options.name: --overrides-dir
options.description: Optional directory containing supplementary markdown sidecar override files

options.name: --msdocs-url
options.description: Base URL for Microsoft Learn API documentation links [default: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/]

options.name: --external-docs
options.description: Custom third-party documentation link mappings in NamespacePrefix=UrlTemplate format []

options.name: --nav-file
options.description: Optional path to an existing or target MkDocs YAML file (mkdocs.yml or mkdocs.nav.yml) to generate or extend

options.name: --nav-format
options.description: Target static-site navigation generator format (MkDocs by default, None to disable, or any custom plugin format name). [default: MkDocs]

options.name: --nav-entry-point
options.description: Optional navigation entry point section path (e.g. 'API Reference' or 'Developer Guide/API Reference') or comment placeholder where generated navigation should be inserted

options.name: --nav-url-prefix
options.description: Optional relative URL prefix prepended to generated Markdown links in the MkDocs navigation (e.g. 'api')

options.name: --diagram-format
options.description: Preferred diagram generator format for type and index pages (for example Mermaid, PlantUml, None, or any custom plugin format; defaults to Mermaid and falls back to another registered generator when a diagram type is unsupported) [default: Mermaid]

options.name: --clean
options.description: Clean existing Markdown (.md) and PlantUML (.puml) files in the output directory prior to export [default: False]

options.name: --fail-on-undocumented
options.description: Minimum required documentation coverage percentage (0.0 to 100.0). Export fails if coverage is below this threshold

options.name: --strict
options.description: Enable strict relative link validation; fails export if any relative Markdown link cannot be resolved [default: False]

options.name: --report-file
options.description: Optional output file path for the structured documentation quality and diagnostics report.

options.name: --report-format
options.description: Output format for the documentation quality report: Json (default), Markdown, Sarif, or a custom plugin format name. [default: Json]

options.name: --plugins-dir
options.description: Optional directory path containing external plugin assemblies (.dll) implementing IDocumentationExporterPlugin.

options.name: --log-level
options.description: Console logging minimum level (Trace, Debug, Information, Warning, Error, Critical, None) [default: Information]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information
